Test Case: Open the Output menu on a study route
Expected Result: Menu shows Export as PNG / Export as PDF / Print options

Test Case: Check the Output button on non-study routes (dashboard/glossary)
Export the Analyze view as PNG
Expected Result: PNG downloads and matches the on-screen study (structure/notes/colors/connections)

Test Case: Export the Analyze view as PDF
Expected Result: PDF downloads and renders the study accurately

Test Case: Export a study with connections and quick notes visible
Expected Result: All visible annotations appear in the export

Test Case: Hide some elements via View toggles then export
Expected Result: Hidden elements are excluded from the export

Test Case: Export while zoomed to a non-100% level
Expected Result: Export output is not distorted by zoom level
Full width is captured without clipping

Test Case: Use Output > Print from the Analyze view
Expected Result: Print dialog opens with an accurate raster capture of the study

Test Case: Use Output > Print from the Document view
Expected Result: Print dialog opens with the live document; pagination is sensible

Test Case: Print (or save as PDF from print dialog) and inspect the result
Expected Result: Text is legible, no cut-off content, headers/footers acceptable

Test Case: Export a very large study (many chapters)
Expected Result: Export completes without crash; output is complete
App returns to normal state with no side effects
